whatYouGet.zh-Hant: 給開源專案的 GitHub Actions runner 支援（官方目前列出 Celery、Ladybird、Zen、Limbo 等受支持專案）；一般帳號另有每月 3,000 分鐘免費額度
whatYouGet.zh-Hans: 面向开源项目的 GitHub Actions runner 支持（官方目前列出 Celery、Ladybird、Zen、Limbo 等受支持项目）；普通账号另有每月 3,000 分钟免费额度
whatYouGet.en: GitHub Actions runner support for open source projects (currently listed: Celery, Ladybird, Zen, Limbo); every account also gets 3,000 free minutes per month

whyItHelps.zh-Hant: 把 GitHub Actions 換到效能更高的 runner，只要改一行 runs-on，CI 等待時間縮短，貢獻者更快拿到測試結果。
whyItHelps.zh-Hans: 把 GitHub Actions 换到性能更高的 runner，只需改一行 runs-on，CI 等待时间缩短，贡献者更快拿到测试结果。
whyItHelps.en: Swap GitHub Actions onto faster runners by changing one runs-on line, so contributors get CI results sooner.

requirements.zh-Hant: 持續維護的公開儲存庫、寬鬆型（permissive）開源授權、有明確的社群使用；在定價頁的 OSS Program 表單申請
requirements.zh-Hans: 持续维护的公开仓库、宽松型（permissive）开源许可证、有明确的社区使用；在定价页的 OSS Program 表单申请
requirements.en: Actively maintained public repo, permissive OSS license and clear community usage; apply via the OSS Program form on the pricing page

pending.zh-Hant: 開源專案實際取得的分鐘數、折扣或期限未公開
pending.zh-Hans: 开源项目实际获得的分钟数、折扣或期限未公开
pending.en: The minutes, discount or term granted to OSS projects are not published
